briefing.headline: DeepSeek-R2 open-weight release intensifies US-China AGI race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid compute constraints. Prompt injection and multi-agent risks dominate security discussions while DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation gains traction in enterprise pilots.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys internal Orion-2 for reasoning benchmarks. Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus. Google Gemini 3 preview and Meta Llama 4 405B compete with xAI Grok-4. DeepSeek-R2 leads open-source multimodal performance.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins with new red-teaming mandates.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for NVIDIA Blackwell. Microsoft and Google announce $50B combined data center expansions. Power grid constraints delay several Middle East hyperscale projects.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent dialect protocols become standard infrastructure before the first agentic AGI deployment?
